record.name: Netlify
record.one_liner: Netlify provides a REST API and SDKs for managing sites, deploys, DNS, and form submissions programmatically.

auth.notes: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication and public integrations, and also supports personal access tokens (PATs) passed via the Authorization Bearer header.

access.notes: Free tier plans and general developer accounts are available to sign up and start building immediately.

api_surface.notes: Exposes a public REST API along with Go, JS, and Netlify SDK clients.

mcp.notes: Netlify offers a Netlify MCP Server to share context and connect AI assistants to a Netlify account for deployment workflows.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve accounts and comprehensive REST API/SDK documentation make integrations easy to build.

evidence.claim: Netlify uses a REST API and OAuth2/personal access tokens for authentication.
Mentions Netlify REST API, Netlify SDK, and Netlify MCP Server.
Provides the Netlify SDK for extending the platform and workflows.
